questions.question_text:
A club had $780$ badges, made $265$ more, then gave away $190$.
How many badges remained?

options.why: Added the $190$ badges instead of subtracting those given away.
Subtracted both $265$ and $190$ from the starting number.
Stopped after combining the original and newly made badges.

questions.question_text:
A farm stored $1\,420$ bales, used $375$, then stored another $260$.
How many bales were stored afterwards?

options.why: Subtracted the later $260$ bales instead of adding them.
Stopped after subtracting the bales that were used.
Added both changes to the starting amount, including the bales used.

questions.question_text:
A player began a game with $645$ points, gained $587$ points and lost $469$ points.
How many points did she have at the end?

options.why: Added the $469$ points lost instead of subtracting them.
Stopped after adding the points gained and ignored the loss.
Calculated the gain minus the loss but omitted the starting $645$ points.

questions.question_text:
A traveller went $826$ km by train, $743$ km by bus and $58$ km on foot.
What was the total distance travelled?

options.why: Added the train and bus distances but omitted the $58$ km on foot.
Subtracted the $58$ km on foot instead of adding it.
Subtracted the bus distance from the train distance, then added the distance on foot.

questions.question_text:
A depot had $1\,865$ parcels, received $417$ parcels and then sent out $536$ parcels.
How many parcels remained?

options.why: Added the $536$ parcels sent out instead of subtracting them.
Subtracted the received parcels as well as the parcels sent out.
Stopped after adding the received parcels and ignored the parcels sent out.

questions.question_text:
A player began a game with $20\,580$ points, gained $9\,475$ points and lost $11\,687$ points.
How many points did she have at the end?

options.why: Added the $11\,687$ points lost instead of subtracting them.
Stopped after adding the points gained and ignored the loss.
Subtracted both the points gained and the points lost from the starting total.

questions.question_text:
A traveller went $138$ km by train, $167$ km by bus and $29$ km on foot.
What was the total distance travelled?

options.why: Added the train and bus distances but omitted the $29$ km on foot.
Subtracted the $29$ km on foot instead of adding it.
Added the bus and walking distances but omitted the $138$ km by train.

questions.solution_text:
$138+167$
$=305$
$305+29$
$=334$
The total distance travelled was $334$ km.

questions.question_text:
A traveller went $17\,685$ km by train, $9\,748$ km by bus and $267$ km on foot during a long journey.
What was the total distance travelled?

options.why: Added the train and bus distances but omitted the $267$ km on foot.
Subtracted the $267$ km on foot instead of adding it.
Subtracted the bus distance from the train distance, then added the distance on foot.
